title: LTcommands
description: This LittleTiles addon adds event (like sounds) for activating commands for doors.
body: # LTcommands **LTcommands** is an add-on for LittleTiles that adds a new event for interactive doors. This event executes a command specified by you when the door is opened or closed. You can also use the `{player}` placeholder to insert the nickname of the player who clicked on the door into the command. ## 📲 Installation The mod requires [LittleTiles](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/littletiles) and [CreativeCore](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/creativecore) to work. Download and install them. ## ❓ How to use In the door settings, go to Events and create an Execute Command event.
